name: Cosmological Heap Analysis

phase_0.boundary_condition: The session engine runtime environment containing the six section-registers.

VINIT.justification: The invariant initialization stage providing the pre-session structural environment before any plant-specific routing occurs.

TANCH.justification: The final closed instruction set that binds the abstract recipe to physical parameters, completing the executable.

AFWD.justification: The forward progression from cosmological constants to a specific folio address in the botanical catalog.

AREV.justification: The backwards-compatible validation that prevents activation energy (heat) from being applied to frozen-order kinetics.

CLINK.justification: The composition of an abstract opcode with a specific IG primitive value to form a quantified step.

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-referential endpoint where successive fractions reproduce the same structural pattern, identifying the process as complete.

FSPLIT.justification: The divergence of the operation stream into thermal and containment sub-branches based on vessel capacity.

FFUSE.justification: The reunification of multiple extraction fractions into a single homogenized yield that preserves the initial plant charge identity.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative state where transcription sources H/F/U agree on the winding class.

EVALF.justification: The failure state where a plant is not addressable by the standard pharmacy catalog or the vessel capacity is exceeded.

ENGAGR.justification: A paradice state where H/F/U sources disagree, maintaining the disagreement as a signal of structural transition.

IFIX.justification: The permanent append-only record of the final pharmaceutical instruction for the practitioner.

phase_3.void_description: Pre-initialization state where the botanical name exists without an associated tuple or session.
phase_3.true_description: Successful gate passage where the structural parameters satisfy the vessel and winding constraints.
phase_3.false_description: The session aborts because the structural depth of the plant exceeds the capacity of the current register.
phase_3.both_description: Indeterminacy in the astronomical winding register where multiple possible cycle counts are held simultaneously.

Closure of the session register and release of the elaborated protocol to the practitioner.
